status: Implemented; sanitizer tests and read-only producer-file probe passed; QEMU stock-firmware integration pending.
sampling: 32×20 cells, 4×4 sample locations per cell, average RGB8 shifted left eight bits; alpha ignored.
snapshot_behavior: Read even sequence, sample, recheck sequence before atomic grid commit. Reuse last stable grid during a busy or changing writer. Reuse cached grid for unchanged publication. Invalid metadata/no published frame falls back to the existing guest OSD sampler.
work_bound: 10,240 pixel locations and 30,720 color-byte loads per new frame; no complete image copy. Cached output copy is 3,840 bytes. File metadata check and mmap page faults can still incur host work.

coverage: All grid positions and RGB averaging
RGBA channel order and alpha ignored
Odd writer sequence preserves prior grid
Deterministic sequence change before commit rejects new grid
Invalid magic, version, width, height, stride and format
Zero frame count, wrong size and unaligned input
Actual mmap and detected prior truncation

producer_file_probe.interpretation: Read-only adapter probe of an existing blue posted frame; does not establish stock Ambilight output.

limitations: This graphics translation development path is not Mali hardware emulation or calibrated sensor behavior.
Source is a trusted renderer file that must retain its inode and size for the run; a concurrent hostile truncate cannot be made safe by fstat before mmap reads.
A busy or unchanged producer can retain the last stable frame; no new-frame freshness guarantee.
Physical LED geometry and calibration remain synthetic/unverified.
